I have moved this site, long hosted on Ameba Ownd, to [Quarto](https://quarto.org) + GitHub Pages.

## Why I moved

- The page limit on the free plan had become cramped
- Every time I logged into my account I got an error, which made updating the site itself a chore
- I wanted a place to show the tools and systems I have built with vibe coding
- I wanted to be able to blog a bit more casually

## The new setup

I can write directly in Markdown, continuous with the Obsidian vault I use every day, and the site builds automatically when I push to GitHub. Research output is structured in YAML frontmatter, so it can be filtered and sorted however I like later. No more struggling with CMS logins.
